$comment: Known divergences between the two 42-check engines, pinned to the canonical hash of BOTH sides. kind=intentional: the copies differ by design (transport, output envelope). kind=debt: a fix landed in route.ts and was never ported; porting it and deleting the entry is the goal. See scripts/source-drift.mjs.

const:REMEDIATION.why: Fix-it copy for v24, v34-v41 and S1-S7 was revised in route.ts only. Verdicts are unaffected; the CLI prints older remediation text than the site.

fn:checkButtonTextVerb.why: v38: route.ts strips aria-hidden children, falls back to aria-label for 1-2 character labels, and exempts selection controls (isSelectionControl). engine.ts has none of these, so the CLI can FAIL icon buttons the site passes.

fn:checkDesignMdSpec.why: v37: transport differs by design (route.ts safeFetch, engine.ts httpsFetch plus SSRF guard), but the branch results also differ. route.ts SKIPs a served file with no frontmatter while engine.ts WARNs. Network-dependent, so the offline parity fixture cannot see it.

fn:checkFontFamilyCount.why: v26: verdict-equivalent. route.ts writes the unresolved-token skip as if/else, engine.ts as a guard clause, and engine.ts defaults tokens to {}. Porting either shape to the other closes this entry.

fn:emitCanonical.why: The canonical output format differs. route.ts emits schemaVersion, generatedAt, tool, subject, per-category counts and severity-mapped findings; engine.ts emits a reduced shape under the same format name, so `--format canonical` from the CLI does not match the API.

fn:emitDesignesy.why: Output envelope. route.ts attaches a receipt (buildReceipt) for the HTTP API and strips the internal retrievedAt; the package returns the result as-is.

fn:emitGoogle.why: engine.ts adds score and grade to summary; route.ts does not. Same format name, different fields across the CLI and the API.

fn:emitReview.why: route.ts uses deriveVerdict(), which returns not-scored when every check SKIPs or is MANUAL; engine.ts inlines fail/needs-changes/pass, so an all-SKIP result reads as pass in the CLI's review.

fn:fetchPageResilient.why: Transport. route.ts uses fetch via fetchCssSingleDetailed and reports a typed failure reason; engine.ts uses node:https with an SSRF guard (isValidUrl, safeLookup).

fn:inferTokensFromCss.why: Alias fallback loop. route.ts stops at the first alias that exists, even if it resolves to an empty string; engine.ts keeps trying aliases until one yields a truthy value. They differ only when an alias resolves to empty.

slop:S11.why: route.ts suppresses S11 on pages that document the slop rules (isDocumentingSlopRules); engine.ts does not.

slop:S12.why: route.ts suppresses S12 on pages that document the slop rules (isDocumentingSlopRules); engine.ts does not.

slop:S2.why: route.ts widened the grid-pattern exemption to color-mix(), var() and hex stops in both orders; engine.ts only exempts transparent/rgba before 1px. The CLI flags hairline-grid backgrounds that the site does not.

slop:S8.why: route.ts suppresses S8 on pages that document the slop rules (isDocumentingSlopRules); engine.ts does not.

slop:S9.why: route.ts suppresses S9 on pages that document the slop rules (isDocumentingSlopRules); engine.ts does not.
